rows.label: tlk45500153_01_msg0001
rows.name:
If you're visiting the imperial
capital, Alba Margen, don't miss our
famous hot springs.

rows.label: tlk45500153_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm sure you must have noticed that
there's natural steam rising from
the ground all over these parts.

rows.label: tlk45500153_01_msg0003
rows.name:
There are plants too, but we also have
lots of public steam baths that use
the natural steam.

rows.label: tlk45500153_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Alba Margen is a stiff
city, so baths are one of
our few ways to unwind.

rows.label: tlk45500153_01_msg0005
rows.name:
I make sure to visit every
day, myself. Hahaha!
